parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 2.2x (AP2204K-3.3TRG1: 2.2 µF p.2 vs TPS7A2433DBVR: 1 µF p.5); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: TPS7A2433DBVR is rated to only 18 V rec. (20 V abs max, p.4) vs AP2204K-3.3TRG1 at 24 V rec. (38 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 supplies up to 150 mA (p.5) compared to TPS7A2433DBVR at 200 mA (p.5); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AP2204K-3.3TRG1: 360 mV p.5 vs TPS7A2433DBVR: 160 mV p.6); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TPS7A2433DBVR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (20 V, p.4) than AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (38 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 20 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 49% higher on AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (AP2204K-3.3TRG1: 250 °C/W p.4 vs TPS7A2433DBVR: 167.8 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP2204K-3.3TRG1: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C TA; -40°C to +125°C TJ) vs TPS7A2433DBVR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP2204K-3.3TRG1 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
CAUTION LIFECYCLE STATUS (NRND): AP2204K-3.3TRG1 is flagged NRND by Diodes Incorporated; do not design into new production layouts — evaluate Active alternatives.
engineering_verdict: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and TPS7A2433DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because minimum output capacitance requirement differs 2.2x; Vin,max rating drops >=20%; Iout,max rating drops >=20%. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 63.8 °C on AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (θJA 250 °C/W) vs 42.8 °C on TPS7A2433DBVR (θJA 167.8 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 10x ratio (20 µA (p.5) vs 2 µA (p.6)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 "Severe 24 V High-Voltage Thermal Derating in SOT-23-5 (θJA = 250 °C/W Limits Load < 20 mA)" (p.4) and TPS7A2433DBVR "Large/Fast VIN Line Transients Trigger Brief Output Shutdown (Section 8.1.8, p.17)" (p.17). BOM decision: Choose AP2204K-3.3TRG1 when input rails climb above 18 V (rated to 24 V); choose TPS7A2433DBVR when load current exceeds 150 mA (up to 200 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 2 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
